meta.oneLinePitch: A cross-platform Expo Router app (Android + Web) backed by Firebase Auth + Firestore.
meta.llmRole: You are a senior React Native (Expo) engineer. Treat this JSON as the source of truth. Do not deviate.

runtime.localDev: Expo dev server on local machine

product.problem: Describe the problem the app solves.
coreUserJourneys: User can sign up / sign in / sign out
User can see authenticated area only when logged in
User can create/read/update/delete a core entity stored in Firestore
nonGoals: No iOS-specific work unless required later
successCriteria: Runs on Android device/emulator and Web

notes: Document exact EAS commands in README

architecture.pattern: Feature-first with Expo Router route groups
rules: No business logic inside screens; use src/lib/*
All Firestore reads/writes must go through a small lib layer
Auth-gated navigation must be enforced with Expo Router layouts

requirements: Auth state listener with loading state
Protected route group for signed-in users
Consistent error messages for auth failures

securityRules: Users can only access their own documents unless explicitly public

definitionOfDone: README includes setup + run + build steps

workflow: Propose data model + screens + route groups first
Implement: Firebase init -> auth provider -> auth screens -> protected layouts -> Firestore CRUD -> rules
After each milestone: list changed files + run commands + manual verification checklist
outputFormat: Always include file paths with full code blocks
Prefer complete file outputs over partial snippets
No new dependencies unless explicitly allowed and justified
constraints: Router is Expo Router (LOCKED): do not switch to React Navigation
Backend is Firebase only: do not add separate server
Keep Android + Web compatible code as a hard requirement
